title: Harnessing MPI mutations for AI error detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.20616v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: MPI errors are challenging to identify despite the significant number of expert verification tools. Dynamic tools (i.e., requiring profiling) are computationally expensive and accurate in error detection, whereas static analysis (i.e., operating at source code or compilation) is computationally cheap but less accurate. Interestingly, the recent success of AI and LLMs offers an alternative to increase static analysis accuracy while preserving its low overhead. Yet current methods remain difficult to benchmark, too general, and poorly adapted to the specific challenges of high-performance computing. In this paper, we investigate how AI-powered tools can efficiently and accurately detect errors in real-world MPI applications. We propose a novel MPI Mutated Dataset (MMD), constructed from MPI programs extracted from thousands of open-source GitHub projects. translated_title: 利用MPI变异进行AI错误检测
translated_abstract: 尽管已有大量专家验证工具，MPI错误仍然难以识别。动态工具（即需要运行时性能分析的工具）计算开销大但在错误检测方面较为准确，而静态分析（即在源代码或编译阶段进行分析）计算成本低但准确性较差。有趣的是，近期AI和大语言模型的成功提供了一种新的途径，可以在保持静态分析低开销的同时提高其准确性。然而，现有方法仍然难以进行基准测试、过于通用，且未能很好地适应高性能计算领域的特定挑战。在本文中，我们研究了AI驱动的工具如何高效且准确地检测真实世界中MPI应用程序的错误。我们提出了一种新颖的MPI变异据集，该数据集基于从数千个开源GitHub项目中提取的MPI程序构建而成。在排序和过滤这些文件后，我们注入错误来真实地模拟（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于数千个GitHub开源项目构建的新型MPI变异据集（MMD），用于支持AI驱动的工具在保持静态分析低开销的同时，高效准确地检测真实MPI应用程序中的错误。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel MPI Mutated Dataset (MMD) built from thousands of GitHub open-source projects, enabling AI-powered tools to efficiently and accurately detect errors in real-world MPI applications while preserving the low overhead of static analysis.
